title: 'Disgusting, reprehensible, irresponsible'
article: A letter from Wally Sambirsky, Kingston.

Truscott. Since when does a death due to a heart attack warrant two pages of coverage in The Whig? I find it disgusting, reprehensible and irresponsible that The Whig published this sensationalizing smut. Has The Whig regressed to rag status?

Let's be respectful to the deceased, and also to our police. If the Taser used by police played no role in Mr. Truscott's death, then drop it as not being part of the story, other than telling us it was used.
